description: Calles is a dataset listed in City of Buenos Aires open data portal (BA Data), an open data portal, published or maintained by Jefatura de Gabinete de Ministros. Este conjunto de datos contiene el listado completo de calles de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires junto con su referencia geográfica. Además, se incluyen sugerencias para su integración y uso en herramientas como QGIS y Open Street Routing Machine (OSRM), facilitando el análisis espacial y el cálculo de rutas. Coverage: Ciudad de Buenos Aires. The portal files it under the publisher Jefatura de Gabinete de Ministros. Its tags are autopistas, calles, congestión, red-vial, shp. It offers 5 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, XLSX, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-01 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-2.5-AR. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-caba-portal.
